prompt:
You ordered a washing machine from an online shop. It arrived two weeks late, and when it was installed you found that it was damaged.

Write a letter to the customer services manager of the shop. In your letter:
• give details of your order
• describe the problems with the delivery and the machine
• say what you would like the shop to do

Write at least 150 words. You do not need to include any addresses.
Begin your letter with: Dear Sir or Madam,

stimulus.situation: You ordered a washing machine from an online shop. It arrived two weeks late, and when it was installed you found that it was damaged.
stimulus.recipient: the customer services manager of the shop
points: describe the problems with the delivery and the machine
say what you would like the shop to do

text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about a washing machine which I ordered from your online shop last month.

I placed the order on 3 March for a Brightwash 7 kg washing machine, order number BW-48213, and paid 420 euros including delivery. According to your website, the machine should be delivered within five working days.

Unfortunately, it arrived two weeks late, on 24 March, and nobody informed me about the delay although I called your service line twice. When your technician installed the machine, we found that the door was cracked and the drum makes a loud noise when it turns. I have not been able to use it since it arrived, so I have to go to a laundrette every week.

I would be grateful if you could replace the machine with a new one as soon as possible and collect the damaged one from my home. I also think that a refund of the delivery cost would be fair, considering the delay.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,
Anna Kowalska

prompt:
A friend looked after your home and your pet while you were away on holiday.

Write a letter to your friend. In your letter:
• thank your friend for their help
• tell them about your holiday
• offer to do something for them in return

Write at least 150 words. You do not need to include any addresses.
Begin your letter with: Dear …,

stimulus.situation: A friend looked after your home and your pet while you were away on holiday.
points: thank your friend for their help
offer to do something for them in return

text:
Dear Sam,

I just wanted to say a huge thank you for looking after the flat and Biscuit while I was away. I know how busy you've been at work, so it really means a lot. Biscuit clearly had a great time with you – he's been sulking ever since I got back!

The holiday was fantastic. We spent the first few days in Lisbon, wandering around the old town and eating far too many custard tarts, and then took the train down to the coast. The beaches were almost empty because it was the end of the season, and the water was still warm enough to swim. The highlight was a boat trip along the cliffs, where we saw dolphins swimming right next to us. I'll show you the photos when we meet.

Anyway, I'd love to return the favour. You mentioned that you're going to visit your parents in December, so why don't I water your plants and collect your post while you're away? And let me take you out for dinner next weekend – my treat, of course.

Let me know when you're free.

Lots of love,
Maria
